items.followUp: How are sugars transported from a source to a sink in a plant?

rubric.why: A source supplies sugars for transport through the plant.
rubric.description: States that a source produces or supplies sugars.
rubric.how: Award for identifying a source as a plant part that produces or supplies sugars, usually a photosynthesising leaf.

rubric.why: A sink uses sugars or stores them for later use.
rubric.description: States that a sink uses or stores sugars.
rubric.how: Award for identifying a sink as a plant part that uses sugars for growth or stores them.

modelAnswer: A source is a plant part, usually a photosynthesising leaf, that produces and supplies sugars.
A sink is a plant part that uses sugars for growth or stores them.
